notes: This run validates the context capacity fix against actual Windows calls. The debugger observes 32768 private bytes, a successful one-rectangle present, a nonempty 32-byte DMA/64-byte private packet, successful patch/submit and completed CPU copy fence.

DXGI still returns DXGI_STATUS_OCCLUDED and the probe fails before its pixel oracle. Kernel copy completion is not displayed-frame delivery. No bugcheck occurs and resources and driver are removed cleanly.

The runner launches the probe with WindowStyle Hidden, and the probe does not assert IsWindowVisible or hold ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED. A later console snapshot shows the display asleep, but its state at the exact present is not captured. Window startup visibility and display idle state remain possible confounders; an awake/normal-launch control is required.

This package uses the previous UMD returning S_OK from CreateDevice. The separately built c3e3e8f UMD returns DXGI_STATUS_NO_REDIRECTION as required without shared D3D9 hardware; its effect needs its own live measurement.
Debugger breakpoints automatically dump Present/Patch arguments and continue. This is functional evidence, not a latency or performance benchmark.
